top_signals.title: China mounts fresh campaign to encircle Taiwan with patrols
top_signals.summary: Since June, Beijing has deployed on average two Coast Guard cutters per month east of Taiwan, an area vital to U.S. allies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
